skill_name: Summarize the advantages of taking a gap year.
workflow: Taking a gap year has many advantages. It can provide an opportunity to gain a broader perspective on life, to pursue interests, to travel, to do volunteer service or to gain an understanding of different cultures. It can also provide significant time for personal growth and reflection, as well as academic and professional development. A gap year can provide valuable work experience and specialized training, which can be very helpful for college admissions and for competitive job applications. I
